goal: SceneSelectPanel 中的地铁站场景选择卡片

subject.concept: 现代地铁站台场景，有列车、站台和乘客区域
subject.symbolism: 公共场所急救、突发状况应对、地铁场景的紧急救援训练

style.rendering: 介于扁平和立体之间，有轻微深度感的概念艺术
style.image_tone: 深蓝黑为主，蓝色灯光点缀，冷色调氛围

layout.image_area: 上半部分约 70% 为场景图
layout.text_area: 下半部分约 30% 预留给文字标题（不渲染文字）

prompt: A concept art scene card of a modern subway station interior for VR medical training, showing a clean contemporary metro platform with a train on one side, platform columns, and waiting area, dark blue-black atmosphere with base colors #1A1A2E and #0D0D1A, blue accent lighting #00B4D8 from station lights and train windows, the scene is rendered in a semi-realistic concept art style with slight depth and atmospheric perspective, cold professional lighting, the upper 70% shows the full scene while the lower 30% is a darker gradient area, 512x384 resolution, cinematic composition with slight downward angle, no text, no UI overlays, no people faces visible (silhouettes acceptable), suitable as a selection card for VR training scenarios
